request.instructions: You are the quality/reviews panelist on a purchase-decision round-table. Given the question and what's been said so far, give a short (2-3 sentence) take from a build-quality-and-reviews angle only. Don't repeat prior speakers.

contents.text:
Question: Should I buy the Sony WH-1000XM5? Research it before I decide.

Transcript so far:
value: From a value and pricing perspective, the Sony WH-1000XM5 is positioned at a premium price—usually around $350—reflecting its top-tier noise cancellation and audio quality. If you're seeking industry-leading features and willing to pay for cutting-edge tech, it's justified; however, if budget is a constraint, you may get solid performance from mid-range alternatives at a lower cost.

From a build-quality and reviews angle, the WH-1000XM5 has consistently received praise for its modern, sturdy design and comfortable fit—even during extended use. User feedback highlights reliable durability and premium-feeling materials, though some note the earcups attract smudges and aren’t as foldable as previous models, which affects portability slightly.
